Hi Emma —

Great to meet earlier this week. Per our call, were ready to get Brightleaf set up in both Whistic and OneTrust so you can pull our CAIQ and SIG artifacts and we can complete the portal intake faster. Two small asks to get the onboarding moving: 

1) Can you confirm the portal admin(s) youd like us to grant access to in Whistic/OneTrust?
2) Do you have a preferred SSO test window? We can provide SP metadata (SAML) and a short test plan.
3) Which evidence types do you want up front (SOC 2 report, KMS rotation proof, CAIQ spreadsheet, SIG CSV)?

Ive attached a short SSO checklist and our CAIQ starter to accelerate answers. If you prefer, were happy to do a 30-minute walk-through of the portal and evidence layout next week.

Thanks — Ill loop in our security intake owners to prep the files.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the note — were excited to move forward. Quick answers below: 

- Portal admins: I and our Security Ops lead (security@brightleafhealth.com). Add us as "Vendor Admin" in Whistic and "Primary Contact" in OneTrust.
- SSO test window: Tue, Apr 27 between 10:00-12:00 PT works best.
- Evidence: please prioritize CAIQ spreadsheet and SIG export; SOC 2 summary and KMS rotation proof are fine to attach but CAIQ/sig are the critical path.

For SSO we need your SP metadata (EntityID, ACS URL, certificate) and a short test plan (we do one assert/sign-on test + metadata validation). I attached a short vendor-side OneTrust SSO checklist that shows the fields we will configure.

One small note: we prefer that vendor uploads to Whistic be done via an "admin upload" so we can review before publish. Ill open a ticket in our portal for the onboarding session and email the DocuSign link for the standard NDA (procurement) once Security signs off.

Emma
